info.name: CreatorConnect - Hiring Service
info.description:
Hiring Service APIs — freelancers apply to projects, creators manage and decide on applications.

Base URL: http://localhost:8084 (direct).

Setup:
1. Register + login via the Auth Service to obtain JWTs for a FREELANCER and a CREATOR.
2. Paste the freelancer's token into the collection variable `freelancerToken` and the creator's token into `creatorToken`.
3. After creating a project (Project Service), copy its `id` into the collection variable `projectId`.
4. After applying, copy the application `id` from the response into the collection variable `applicationId`.

Endpoints:
- POST   /applications                     Apply to project (freelancer only — 409 if already applied)
- GET    /applications/my                  Get my applications (paginated: page, size)
- GET    /applications/project/{projectId} Get applications for project (creator only)
- PUT    /applications/{id}/status         Accept/reject application (creator only)
- DELETE /applications/{id}                Withdraw application (own application only)

request.description:
Submits an application for the authenticated freelancer. The freelancerId is read from the JWT — never from the body. Fields: projectId (required), proposal (required, max 5000 chars), expectedBudget (required, >= 0), estimatedDuration (required, max 50 chars). Status always starts as PENDING.

Expected: 201 CREATED.
Errors: 400 invalid payload · 401 missing/invalid JWT · 403 not a freelancer · 409 already applied to this project.

Returns every application submitted by the authenticated freelancer (freelancerId from the JWT), most recently submitted first. The page object is carried in data.content.

Expected: 200 OK.
Errors: 401 missing/invalid JWT.

Returns the applications received by the given project, most recently submitted first (creator role required). Verifying the creator owns the project is deferred to Day 6 (data lives in the Project Service).

Expected: 200 OK.
Errors: 400 invalid project id · 401 · 403 not a creator.

Assigns a new status to the application (creator role required). Valid decisions: ACCEPTED or REJECTED. The application must still be PENDING.

Expected: 200 OK.
Errors: 400 invalid payload/decision · 401 · 403 not a creator · 404 application not found · 409 application no longer pending.

Withdraws the application with the given id (soft-delete — status becomes WITHDRAWN). Only the freelancer who submitted it may withdraw it, and only while it is PENDING.

Expected: 200 OK with null data.
Errors: 400 invalid id · 401 · 403 not the application's freelancer · 404 not found · 409 no longer pending.

A freelancer tries to read a project's incoming applications.

Expected: 403 Forbidden — only creators may view applications for a project.
